shell_commands: ls node_modules/.cache/mongodb-binaries/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No mongodb-binaries cache directory"
cat jest.config.js 2>/dev/null || cat jest.config.ts 2>/dev/null || cat jest.config.json 2>/dev/null || echo "No jest config file found"
ls /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target/jest.*.* 2>/dev/null || ls /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target/jest.* 2>/dev/null || echo "No jest setup files"
git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target add jest.globalSetup.js jest.config.js && git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target status

git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(build): pre-download MongoDB binary before parallel test workers start

Parallel Jest workers that all call MongoMemoryServer.create() race each
other on the binary download rename step. A Jest globalSetup that calls
MongoBinary.getPath() in the main process before any worker is spawned
ensures the binary is already cached, so no worker needs to download it.

Closes the ENOENT rename failure seen in the MongoDB durability test suite.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target push origin HEAD && git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target fetch origin main && git -C /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/c4b763a31855/workspace/target merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1
